headline: Trump Media Transfers $342 Million in Bitcoin to Crypto.com, Data Shows
summary: Blockchain data tracked by Arkham shows a wallet associated with Trump Media transferred $342 million in bitcoin to cryptocurrency exchange Crypto.com.
why: Trump Media & Technology Group is the publicly traded parent company of Truth Social. Large corporate crypto transfers are closely watched by investors for potential treasury management or liquidity moves.
